messages.subject: Color cells in DT using coordinates
parts:
Hi all

In a Shiny app, i am using the package DT to show a datatable. I would like to color some cells of the table but not based on the value of the value (I saw the option styleInterval for that purpose).

I would like to color cells of the datable A based on the values of a datatable B (or get the coordinates of the cells of interest in datatable B and color those cells in the datatable A).

Have you got any idea  ?


Thanks in advance

Sam
